paragraphs.text: Caribou is a seldom used creature type that represents a large deer native to the arctic, subarctic, tundra, boreal, and mountainous regions.

Caribou was introduced as a creature type in Ice Age on Caribou Range , which creates Caribou tokens . They exited on Dominaria during the Ice Age . Caribou has remained exclusive to Caribou Range and no other cards have used the creature type.

External to Magic , the terms "caribou" and "reindeer" usually refer to the same animal species, Rangifer tarandus . Within Magic , caribou stand as a separate species following the printing of Rimefur Reindeer ( Wilds of Eldraine ) as an Elk .
